radar_method: Sentinel-1 GRD IW, VV+VH sigma0 orthorectified, per-pixel median over all acquisitions in the window, then median VV in dB over the box. radar_change_db = latest window minus first window. Built structures usually raise VV backscatter; wet ground, crops and viewing geometry also move it.
